step1_analysis.circuit_type: RC Low-Pass Filter / Track-and-Hold Sampling Network
step1_analysis.description: A simple RC low-pass filter representing the equivalent circuit of a track-and-hold amplifier (THA) in track mode. The resistor models the switch on-resistance and the capacitor models the hold capacitance.

paper_reference.title: A Broadband 10-GHz Track-and-Hold in Si/SiGe HBT Technology

bandwidth.description: -3dB cutoff frequency of the sampling network

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * R * C). With C = 325 fF (from paper) and assuming an effective switch resistance R = 50 ohms, BW ≈ 9.8 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the paper's reported 10 GHz bandwidth and 325 fF hold capacitance.

rise_time.description: 10% to 90% rise time of the output step response

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly related to the RC time constant of the sampling network.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the -3dB bandwidth and step response rise/fall times of the RC track-and-hold equivalent network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RC Track-and-Hold Network Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param R_val=50
.param C_val=325f

* DUT
r IN OUT {R_val}
Ch OUT GND {C_val}

* Sources
VIN IN GND DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0 1.8 100p 1p 1p 500p 1n)

.control
* AC Analysis for Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT)
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=-3 fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Step Response
tran 0.1p 2n
meas tran t_rise trig v(OUT) val=0.18 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=1.62 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(OUT) val=1.62 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.18 fall=1

print bw_3db t_rise t_fall
quit
.endc
.end
